full_name: Steven J. Zipperstein | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2008–2009 History Vera M. Schuyler Institute Fellow Stanford University
bio: Steven J. Zipperstein, the Daniel E. Koshland Professor in Jewish Culture and History at Stanford University, recently completed the biography Rosenfeld’s Lives: Fame, Oblivion, and the Furies of Writing (Yale University Press, forthcoming).
